name: Mission Carb Balance Flour Tortillas (15g Fiber WARNING)
whyItWorks: Promoted as low-carb diet food, but each single tortilla packs a staggering 15g of concentrated modified wheat starch and cellulose fiber. In IBD patients, this massive dose of resistant starch causes explosive colonic fermentation, agonizing gas distention, and watery diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. One of the most notorious grocery trap items for Crohn's and Colitis patients. Always choose regular Mission Super Soft white tortillas instead.
